## Type of change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (`fix:`) — patch release
- [ ] ✨ New feature (`feat:`) — minor release
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (`feat!:` / `BREAKING CHANGE:`) — major release
- [ ] 📝 Docs only
- [ ] 🔧 Chore / CI / refactor

## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated, and `pytest` passes locally
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` is clean (ruff, reuse, gitleaks, codespell)
- [ ] Docs updated (`docs/`, `SPECIFICATION.md`) to match the change
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Version bumped if appropriate (Conventional Commits)
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or large data files committed
